messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "adjust to the minimum effective dose"
set: ["adjust to the minimum effective dose", "adjust diuretic dose to minimize hypovolemia", "doctor may adjust dose", "doctor may need to adjust dose accordingly", "use the lowest effective dose for your condition", "do not adjust dose yourself", "adjust diabetes medicine or insulin dose", "lowest effective dose should be used", "patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "use the lowest dose that is effective in treating your condition", "this can make the medicines less effective", "will not make the medicine less effective", "use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible consistent with individual treatment goals", "this consideration applies to patients who may require additional time to adjust to the drug", "doctor may adjust dose depending on how well you respond to treatment", "doctor may need to adjust diabetes medications"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
